data.description: Explore the dynamic fusion of creativity and sophistication in the Dubai Design District.

data.answer:
TECOM Group launched the project in 2013 to develop a space to encourage creative thinkers and bolster local and international talent related to art, design, culture, and fashion. Its avant-garde architecture, complemented by artistic installations, reflects a commitment to fostering a unique and inspiring environment.

With ongoing phases of development, including the iconic Design Quarter residential project, D3 continues to evolve as a creative epicenter, contributing significantly to Dubai's cultural landscape. The district is not just a physical space but a thriving community where professionals, entrepreneurs, and artists converge, making it a captivating destination for both work and play.

The buildings in the area feature fully-developed offices that are available as co-working spaces too. These co-working spaces offer a wide range of facilites, from high-speed internet to pantry and much more.

In5 is an excellent platform for entrepreneurs and startups providing creative spaces, training and mentorship programs. The strategically positioned multi-functional warehouses in d3 features pre-established infrastructure and top-notch construction standards.

The community has also launched GoFreelance program, streamlining the process and equipping you with all the essentials for an independent future. As part of the GoFreelance community, freelancers gain access to exclusive opportunities for project discovery and bidding.

Popular Buildings in Dubai Design District

Dubai Design Distict houses many high-tech innovative structures. Building 7 Dubai Design District is a distinctive tower that houses various design studios, galleries, and creative spaces. The Block is another building in the area that is a hub for art, design, and retail, featuring galleries, concept stores, and trendy cafes.

You can also find A4 Space, an innovative co-working area that combines a café, design store, and collaborative working environment. Moreover, The Lighthouse, a multi-concept space offers a design store, gallery, and café, promoting regional design and creativity.

Off-Plan Project in Dubai Design District Area

Design Quarter is the first residential project offering real estate investment opportunities in Dubai Design District (d3). The master developer Meraas has partnered with Los Angeles-based artist Steven Harrington to bring his iconic characters to life in the one-of-its-kind project. 

The three-tower residential complex tailored for those with a creative flair, Design Quarter boasts an expansive outdoor pool, a remarkable podium barbecue area, and breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa, this is the ideal setting to relish Dubai's enchanting warm evenings. Whether you prefer a 1 to 3-bedroom loft, duplex, or penthouse, each residence showcases exquisite interior design features, making staying home a delight.

The complex's allure is further heightened by the array of exquisite dining options conveniently located at your doorstep. Anticipated for completion by 2027, this project embodies the epitome of sophisticated living in the heart of Dubai Design District.

Buying a Property in Dubai Design District

The sale price for 1-bedroom apartments in the Design Quarter ranges between AED 1.8M and AED 2.7M. For buying a 2-bedroom apartment in the Design Quarter, the starting price costs AED 2M, while a 3-bedroom apartment can be purchased for AED 3.9M to AED 8.2. Interested buyers can also find penthouses and duplexes in the Design Quarter.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Design District?

data.answer:
Public Transportation in Dubai Design District

The F13 bus operates from the Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro station to Dubai Design District. Alternatively, you can enjoy a scenic ride on a Dubai water taxi to the Dubai Design District station. Moreover, Dubai Design District (d3) offers ample parking facilities, including multi-story car parks and valet services, ensuring convenience for visitors.

Supermarkets in Dubai Design District

There is an All Day Minimart in Dubai Design District Building 1 from where those who work here can buy quick meals and other essentials. Carrefour Supermarket and F Mart Boutique Supermarket are about 10 minutes away from the location.

Shopping Mall in Dubai Design District Dubai

There is no shopping malls within the Dubai Design District location, however you can find many malls near the area. Dubai Mall is 8 minutes away from D3. It is one of the world's largest shopping and entertainment destinations, is located at the heart of Downtown Dubai. Boasting over 1,200 retail outlets, diverse dining options, and iconic attractions like the Dubai Aquarium and the Waterfall, it offers a luxurious and immersive shopping experience.

Wafi City in Oud Metha District is 13 minutes away from D3. Wafi City, an upscale complex in Dubai, combines luxury shopping, dining, and entertainment. Known for its distinctive Egyptian-inspired architecture, it houses high-end boutiques, fine dining restaurants, and the Wafi Mall with a diverse range of international brands.

Moreover, D3 houses many retail options. You can shop at the Chanel Dubai Design District, Adore Boutique or Anaya Collection. You can visit House Of Adore, Art De Vivre, or Artemide, the Dubai Design District shops for home accessories. Alternatively, go to 55 Fifty 7 Jewellery or ARQA Jewellery for jewelry shopping.

Schools and Nurseries in Dubai Design District Area

You can find Blossom by Babilou Nursery in d3 Dubai, while schools are a short drive away from the area. The nearest options are Hartland International School ad North London Collegiate School. Dubai Design District houses many fashion schools like Insititue of Luxury Fashion and Style (FAD) and Dubai Institute of Design and Innovation (DIDI). Moreover, L’ÉCOLE, School of Jewelery Arts offer workshops and programmes for jewellery enthusiasts and professionals.

Hospitals near Dubai Design District Area

There are various hospitals and healthcare services near Dubai Design District. These include Mediclinic City Hospital. Located in the Healthcare City area, it's a prominent hospital known for its comprehensive medical services.

American Hospital Dubai is an excellent nearby option. Situated in Oud Metha, this hospital is recognized for delivering high-quality healthcare services. Latifa Hospital (formerly Al Wasl Hospital) is also a great option in Oud Metha, it's one of the oldest and well-established hospitals in Dubai.

Note that Dubai Design District houses BinSina Pharmacy, a well-known pharmacy chain in the UAE, it is recognized for providing a wide range of pharmaceutical and healthcare products.

Dubai Design District Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Design District (d3) is strategically positioned in the heart of Dubai. Situated just a short distance from the iconic Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, d3 is well-connected to major business and leisure hubs.

The location provides easy access to key areas such as Business Bay, known for its skyscrapers and commercial developmentsl. Additionally, Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and the Dubai World Trade Centre are in close proximity, enhancing the district's prominence as a central hub for creative industries. The surrounding areas offer a mix of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces, contributing to the dynamic atmosphere of Dubai Design District.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Design District Area

data.answer:
The Dubai Design District d3 area offers a dynamic blend of activities and experiences that cater to both creative minds and those seeking cultural and leisure pursuits. Explore the curated art galleries and design studios showcasing the latest trends and innovations in the creative industry.

The district hosts various events and exhibitions, providing a platform for local and international artists to showcase their work. Indulge in a culinary journey with the diverse dining options available, offering a range of international cuisines. Whether it's shopping for unique designer pieces, attending art installations, or savoring a delightful meal with a view, Dubai Design District offers a multifaceted experience for residents and visitors alike.

Cafes, Nightlife Options, and Restaurants in Dubai Design District

Dubai Design District is a culinary hub with several dining options. For gourmet French dishes, you can head over to Chez Charles, one of the most renowned restaurants in d3. Home Bakery Kitchen in Building 7 Dubai Design District is a great option to indulge in cakes, pastries, and doughnuts. Starbucks in Building 4 Dubai Design District is where residents can get their dose of caffeine.

You can try Japanese street food at Akiba Dori or visit Mums Table Dubai Design District for Syrian cuisine. Building 5 Dubai Design District houses the eatery along with Mohalla Restaurant and 1Life Kitchen. Just like Dubai Design District restaurants, the cafes in the area are also famous for their diversity. Sama Dubai Cafe is one of the popular Dubai Design District cafes known for its stylish and artistic ambiance. 

Situated in the Dubai Design District d3, Sky 2.0 is an upscale nightclub that provides sweeping panoramic views of the city. With its expansive outdoor area, this Dubai Design District club offers a stylish setting for you to unwind beneath the stars.

Beaches Near Dubai Design District

Though d3 Dubai doesn't have direct access to beaches, there are several beautiful beaches in Dubai that are within a reasonable driving distance from the community. About a 20-minute drive from d3, Jumeirah Beach is a popular destination with white sandy shores and a picturesque view of the Arabian Gulf. It's adjacent to the Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) area, which offers a beachfront promenade with shops and restaurants.

Located approximately at the same distance from Dubai Design District location, La Mer is a trendy beachfront destination with a variety of shops, restaurants, and water-based activities.

Hotels in Dubai Design District Area

In the vicinity of the Dubai Design District, you'll find many upscale hotels, particularly in the neighboring areas of Business Bay and Downtown Dubai. Among these, the Paramount Hotel stands out as a luxurious 5-star establishment. Drawing inspiration from the illustrious 105-year history of Paramount Pictures, this hotel pays homage to the glamour of Old Hollywood.

Another notable option is the Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Waterfront, 15 minutes away from the location. The hotel is situated in the Business Bay area, offering convenient access to prominent attractions like the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Waterfront, provides a range of contemporary and stylish rooms and suites with modern amenities.

Almost at the same distance is Millennium Central Downtown. The 4-star hotel offers a range of rooms and suites with modern amenities and contemporary designs.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

While not offering traditional outdoor activities, the d3 Waterfront provides a pleasant space for a leisurely stroll along the Dubai Canal. At d3 Waterfront, visitors can enjoy the scenery and public art installations. You can take a walk or cycle along the Dubai Canal Promenade, which is in close proximity to Dubai Design District. Enjoy the views of the water, surrounding architecture, and the cityscape. 

Located on the d3 Waterfront, The Block features a skatepark, its own open-air basketball and volleyball courts, climbing walls, an urban beach as well as outdoor seating and entertainment areas in which you can come and enjoy the gorgeous neighbourhood and experience the unique vibes of d3. Dubai Design District Skatepark provides a dynamic environment for skateboarding enthusiasts, whereas, Dubai Design District basketball court is an excellent sports facilities.

Moreover, the area features fantastic fitness facilities, one of which is Warehouse. The Warehouse Gym d3 provides a variety of fitness services, including weight training, cardio, group classes, and sometimes additional amenities such as personal training. Also, The Most Hair Design Ladies Salon on the ground floor of Building 6 Dubai Design District is one of the top ladies salon.

Community Events

When it comes to Dubai Design District upcoming events, many highly-awaited shows and exhibitions are in the pipeline. Held annually. Dubai Design Week is an important cultural event in the region, organized by D3. Showcasing Dubai's prominence as the design capital of the Middle East, it features exhibitions, installations, talks, and workshops spanning various creative disciplines. Every year, D3 also organizes Sole DXB, the region's most celebrated youth and contemporary culture festival.

Attractions and Landmarks

Promoted as the inaugural urban beach within the city, The Block is the leisure section in d3, featuring sports courts, an open-air fitness facility, a skate park, and a climbing wall. The project recycled 27 tonnes of concrete cleared to pave the way for the Dubai Water Canal.

Burj Kahlifa is 13 minutes away from Dubai Design District. Soaring to a height of 828 meters (2,717 feet), the skyscraper dominates the city skyline and offers breathtaking panoramic views of Dubai and its surroundings. Designed by the renowned architect Adrian Smith, the Burj Khalifa features a sleek, modern design inspired by Islamic architecture. 

Situated 7 minutes drive away from d3 is Zabeel Palace. It is the official residence of the ruler of Dubai, His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. This opulent palace is an architectural gem, surrounded by expansive gardens and serving as both a private residence and a hub for official ceremonies and functions.

Where is Dubai Design District location?

Dubai Design District is positioned along the Al Ain – Dubai road in Dubai, and it is adjacent to the Business Bay community.

Is Dubai Design District worth a visit?

There are many Dubai Design District places to visit free. The community hosts plenty of events in its indoor and outdoor venues. These include workshops, exhibitions, fashion shows, and concerts. You can explore the Lighthouse Dubai Design District a unique concept store in the area where you can shop, eat and socialize.

Is there bank in the area?

Yes, Emirates NBD Bank is located in Dubai Design District area.

Is Dubai Design District a free zone?

Yes, the Dubai Design District (d3) is a free zone. Dubai Design District companies trade services and products, leveraging foreign ownership laws and special tax.

How to go to Dubai Design District?

You can access it via Ras Al Khor Road or Business Bay Crossing if you are driving. If you choose public transportation, your nearest metro station will be the Business Bay Metro Station. You can take a taxi or use local buses to reach your destination within d3.

What to do in Dubai Design District?

There is a lot to see In Dubai Design District (d3). You can find studios, art galleries, fashion boutiques, and dining options. Also, you can explore the outdoor facilities in the area.

How can we reach to The Block Dubai Design District?

The edgy outdoor Dubai Design District park is located on the d3 Waterfront. Once reaching the area, search the map for 57RW+GX3.

How much is rent per annum in Dubai Design District?

The residential properties in the area are still under construction, so there is no rental options available inside the neighborhood.

Is Dubai Design District offer free entrance?

Yes. There is no entry fee for the area.

When did Dubai Design District was opened first?

The project was established in 2013.

How to register in Dubai Design District d3 area?

To initiate the registration of your business in the Dubai Design District and obtain a license, you must complete an application form. Licensing fees within the Dubai Design District typically commence at approximately AED 15,000, and the minimum required share capital stands at a modest AED 50,000.

data.content:
Dubai Design District, or D3, a project by TECOM Group, offers a blend of design, architecture, fashion and food. The purpose-built community features modern office spaces, showrooms, and co-working areas, providing professionals with an inspiring and collaborative environment.

Enjoy the modern architecture and landscaped outdoor areas within Dubai Design District. The area also comprises pop-up shops, restaurants, cafes, recreational facilities, and nightlife options. A hub for creative thinkers, D3 attracts international and local talent, serving as a venue for many concerts, exhibitions, and outdoor events throughout the year.

The community is also home to a residential project set to provide world-class facilities to residents right in the middle of the unique and inspiring environment.

nodes.title: Artistry One Residences
nodes.about:
Artistry One by Select Group is a landmark residential development rising in the heart of Dubai Design District (D3), where architecture, creativity, and waterfront living meet. This 36-storey tower is designed as a sculptural expression of light, form, and transparency, offering a refined collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom residences alongside exclusive 4-bedroom duplex penthouses.

Artistry One Residences are thoughtfully composed with expansive layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and curated material palettes that enhance both comfort and aesthetics. Overlooking the Dubai Canal, Burj Khalifa skyline, and Sheikh Zayed Road, the project blends serene private living with the vibrant energy of the creative district. Developed by Select Group, one of Dubai’s most trusted premium developers, Artistry One Residences at Dubai Design District deliver an elevated lifestyle defined by design, wellness, and seamless city connectivity.

nodes.title: The Edit
nodes.about:
The Edit is a striking new addition to Dubai Design District (D3), a waterfront development by Meraas featuring three sculptural towers and 392 contemporary residences. 

The Meraas project offers 1- to 4-bedroom apartments and a limited number of 5-bedroom penthouses, all crafted with flowing architecture, natural light, and panoramic views of the Dubai skyline and waterfront.

A masterpiece of form and function, The Edit at D3 by Meraas blends modern aesthetics with nature and community. Each tower features wellness zones and social spaces that encourage connection and creativity. 

With exceptional amenities and a design-focused environment, this is a prime opportunity for strong ROI in one of Dubai’s most artistic and high-demand districts.

nodes.title: Atelis
nodes.about:
Atelis by Meraas is a waterfront residential development located in the heart of Dubai Design District (d3). Rising gracefully along the Creekside shoreline, Atelis offers a premium selection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, exclusive 4-bedroom sky villas, and ultra-luxurious 5-bedroom penthouses.

Designed by the world-renowned architectural firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM)—the creative minds behind the Burj Khalifa—Atelis promises residents breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and serene waterfront. At the ground level, the development features cascading water elements, lush garden rooms, and tranquil indoor-outdoor lounges, all curated to offer a sense of privacy and refined exclusivity.

Just minutes from Downtown Dubai, City Walk, and Business Bay, Atelis is the ideal choice for those who value connectivity, creativity, and sophisticated urban living. It presents a thoughtfully curated lifestyle that blends the serenity of resort-style living with the vibrancy of a dynamic city setting.
